newsitem.title: USA: NHL ICE HOCKEY-CANUCKS LW BRASHEAR SUSPENDED FOUR GAMES.
newsitem.headline: NHL ICE HOCKEY-CANUCKS LW BRASHEAR SUSPENDED FOUR GAMES.

text.p: Vancouver Canucks left wing Donald Brashear was suspended four games and fined $1,000 by the National Hockey League Tuesday for sucker punching Los Angeles Kings centre Ian Laperriere on Saturday.

In the third period of Saturday's 4-0 loss to the Kings, Brashear delivered a blind-side punch to Laperriere's head. He received a major penalty for fighting and a game misconduct on the play, but NHL officials felt more serious punishment was warrented.

"As play stopped in the Los Angeles end, a scrum developed with a number of players from each team shoving one another," said NHL senior vice president and discipline chief Brian Burke in handing down the suspension.
"Mr Brashear delivered a blind-side sucker punch to Mr Laperriere's head. Mr Brashear's actions were deliberate and clearly administered with the intent to injure his opponent."
Brashear, who already sat out Sunday's 5-2 loss at Anaheim, will also miss Tuesday's contest against Montreal, Thursday against Phoenix and Saturday against Los Angeles.
